title: Lior and the Ghost
author: Isandro Fairweather
blurb: Odile Okafor, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
